"""Feed list queries against a real SQLite ledger (P0-I6-T02). Provided; do not edit."""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest
from tl_adapters.sqlite.uow import create_schema, open_uow
from tl_core.services.commands import CreateRecord
from tl_core.services.errors import PostNotFoundError
from tl_core.services.feed import PostToFeed, handle_post
from tl_core.services.feed_actions import (
    ReactToPost,
    RetractPost,
    handle_react_to_post,
    handle_retract_post,
)
from tl_core.services.feed_queries import get_post, list_feed
from tl_core.services.links import AddLink, handle_add_link
from tl_core.services.records import handle_create_record

P1 = "project:P123"
P2 = "project:P999"
K1, K2, K3 = "P123-REC-0001", "P123-REC-0002", "P123-REC-0003"


@pytest.fixture
def db(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    path = tmp_path / "tl.db"
    create_schema(path)
    return path


def record(db: Path, key: str, scope: str = P1, actor: str = "user:jo") -> str:
    cmd = CreateRecord(
        actor=actor, source="t", scope=scope, record_type="core.Record", title=f"T {key}", key=key
    )
    with open_uow(db) as uow:
        return handle_create_record(uow, cmd).stream_id


def post(db: Path, body: str, actor: str = "user:mlee", scope: str = P1, **kw: Any) -> str:
    with open_uow(db) as uow:
        cmd = PostToFeed(actor=actor, source="t", scope=scope, body=body, **kw)
        return handle_post(uow, cmd).stream_id


def feed(db: Path, scope: str = P1, **kw: Any) -> Any:
    with open_uow(db, readonly=True) as uow:
        return list_feed(uow, scope, **kw)


def ids(page: Any) -> list[str]:
    return [item.id for item in page.items]


def test_the_project_feed_lists_posts_and_cards_newest_first(db: Path) -> None:
    record(db, K1)
    first = post(db, "first")
    second = post(db, "second")
    page = feed(db)
    assert [i.item_type for i in page.items] == ["post", "post", "card"]
    assert ids(page)[:2] == [second, first]
    assert page.items[0].seq > page.items[1].seq > page.items[2].seq
    assert page.next_before is None and page.suggestions == {}


def test_item_type_filter(db: Path) -> None:
    record(db, K1)
    pid = post(db, "hello")
    assert ids(feed(db, item_type="post")) == [pid]
    cards = feed(db, item_type="card")
    assert [i.item_type for i in cards.items] == ["card"]


def test_other_scopes_are_not_listed(db: Path) -> None:
    post(db, "mine")
    post(db, "theirs", scope=P2)
    assert [i.summary for i in feed(db).items] == ["mine"]
    assert [i.summary for i in feed(db, P2).items] == ["theirs"]


def test_a_post_item_carries_tags_reactions_and_record_ids(db: Path) -> None:
    rec = record(db, K1)
    pid = post(db, f"Spool #{K1} #hold @party:fab-a", importance="low")
    with open_uow(db) as uow:
        for actor in ("user:a", "user:b"):
            cmd = ReactToPost(actor=actor, source="t", scope=P1, post_id=pid, reaction="ack")
            handle_react_to_post(uow, cmd)
    item = feed(db, item_type="post").items[0]
    assert (item.id, item.item_type, item.scope, item.actor) == (pid, "post", P1, "user:mlee")
    assert item.summary == f"Spool #{K1} #hold @party:fab-a"
    assert item.importance == "high" and item.event_count == 1 and not item.retracted
    assert item.record_ids == (rec,)
    assert [(t.kind, t.text, t.start) for t in item.tags] == [
        ("record", K1, 6),
        ("signal", "hold", 21),
        ("mention", "party:fab-a", 27),
    ]
    assert item.tags[0].record_id == rec and item.tags[2].namespace == "party"
    assert item.reactions == {"ack": 2}


def test_a_card_item_carries_its_count_and_subjects(db: Path) -> None:
    r1, r2 = record(db, K1), record(db, K2)
    (card,) = feed(db, item_type="card").items
    assert card.id.startswith("card:")
    assert (card.actor, card.importance, card.event_count) == ("user:jo", "low", 2)
    assert card.summary == "jo created 2 records"
    assert card.record_ids == (r1, r2) and card.tags == ()


def test_a_retracted_post_is_a_tombstone(db: Path) -> None:
    rec = record(db, K1)
    pid = post(db, f"oops #{K1} #hold")
    with open_uow(db) as uow:
        handle_retract_post(
            uow, RetractPost(actor="user:mlee", source="t", scope=P1, post_id=pid, reason="x")
        )
    item = feed(db, item_type="post").items[0]
    assert item.retracted and item.summary == "[retracted]"
    assert item.record_ids == (rec,) and [t.kind for t in item.tags] == ["record"]
    assert ids(feed(db, tag="hold")) == []
    assert ids(feed(db, record_id=rec, item_type="post")) == [pid]


def test_the_record_feed_has_posts_and_cards_about_the_record(db: Path) -> None:
    r1 = record(db, K1)
    r2 = record(db, K2, actor="user:al")
    about_1 = post(db, f"on #{K1}")
    post(db, f"on #{K2}")
    post(db, "on nothing")
    page = feed(db, record_id=r1)
    assert about_1 in ids(page)
    assert all(r1 in i.record_ids for i in page.items)
    assert [i.item_type for i in page.items].count("card") == 1
    assert r2 not in {rid for i in page.items for rid in i.record_ids}


def test_the_one_hop_toggle_adds_items_of_linked_records(db: Path) -> None:
    r1, r2, r3 = record(db, K1), record(db, K2), record(db, K3)
    with open_uow(db) as uow:
        link = AddLink(actor="user:jo", source="t", scope=P1, from_id=r1, to_id=r2)
        handle_add_link(uow, link)
    on_2 = post(db, f"on #{K2}")
    on_3 = post(db, f"on #{K3}")
    plain = feed(db, record_id=r1, item_type="post")
    hop = feed(db, record_id=r1, include_linked=True, item_type="post")
    assert ids(plain) == []
    assert ids(hop) == [on_2]
    assert on_3 not in ids(feed(db, record_id=r1, include_linked=True))
    assert r3


def test_a_suggested_link_does_not_count_as_one_hop(db: Path) -> None:
    r1 = record(db, K1)
    record(db, K2)
    post(db, f"on #{K1}")  # makes a suggested link post -> r1; the post is not a record
    on_2 = post(db, f"on #{K2}")
    assert on_2 not in ids(feed(db, record_id=r1, include_linked=True))


def test_hashtag_feeds(db: Path) -> None:
    record(db, K1)
    held = post(db, f"stop #hold #{K1}")
    topic = post(db, "bevels #Bevel-Damage and #area:A12")
    mention = post(db, "ping @party:fab-a")
    assert ids(feed(db, tag="hold")) == [held]
    assert ids(feed(db, tag="#HOLD")) == [held]
    assert ids(feed(db, tag="bevel-damage")) == [topic]
    assert ids(feed(db, tag="area:a12")) == [topic]
    assert ids(feed(db, tag="@party:fab-a")) == [mention]
    assert ids(feed(db, tag="party:fab-a")) == []
    assert ids(feed(db, tag=K1.lower())) == []  # a record tag is found through its record
    assert ids(feed(db, tag="nothing")) == []


def test_pages_follow_before_seq(db: Path) -> None:
    made = [post(db, f"post {n}") for n in range(5)]
    first = feed(db, limit=2)
    assert ids(first) == [made[4], made[3]] and first.next_before == first.items[-1].seq
    second = feed(db, limit=2, before_seq=first.next_before)
    assert ids(second) == [made[2], made[1]]
    last = feed(db, limit=2, before_seq=second.next_before)
    assert ids(last) == [made[0]] and last.next_before is None
    assert feed(db, limit=5).next_before is None


def test_labels_map_record_ids_to_keys(db: Path) -> None:
    r1 = record(db, K1)
    page = feed(db)
    assert page.labels == {r1: K1}
    post(db, "no records")
    assert feed(db, item_type="post").labels == {}


def test_get_post(db: Path) -> None:
    pid = post(db, "hello #bevel")
    with open_uow(db, readonly=True) as uow:
        item = get_post(uow, P1, pid)
        assert (item.id, item.summary, item.importance) == (pid, "hello #bevel", "normal")
        assert [t.kind for t in item.tags] == ["topic"]
        with pytest.raises(PostNotFoundError):
            get_post(uow, P1, "nope")
        with pytest.raises(PostNotFoundError):
            get_post(uow, P2, pid)
        card = feed(db, item_type="card")
        assert card.items == []
